name: GlinerEngine

test_list.description: Raw input remains unchanged while the configured GLiNER2 Python normalization appends a period only when needed.
Primary text and context are combined and rejected when their aggregate UTF-8 byte count exceeds the configured bound.
Ambiguous GLiNER task names are rejected before native inference.
Repeated SDK question IDs are rejected even when Noul statements differ.
Duplicate labels in one choice are rejected while the same label across different prompts remains valid.
Oversized statements and aggregate question schemas are bounded before native inference.
Ignored installed-artifact integration check runs the configured local model and validates actual bounded outputs.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Explicit model directory, ORT dynamic library, normalization contract, and bounded thread count.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Validated text and questions supplied through the public SDK contract.

output_description: A real local GLiNER2 classification result with model-derived probabilities and no network/model fallback.
